common_cycle_audit.policy: exclude one common right-boundary cycle set using dwell plus the primary 10 ms margin, then reuse it at both cadences

reference_provenance.boundary_policy: only complete HS-to-HS cycles; the contact already active at t_start and the open contact at t_end are boundary-censored

interpretation_limits: A PASS is still development evidence only; the sealed holdout remains required before any profile promotion.
Every evaluated detector has exactly two spheres. The larger single-pass sampler is only an offline batching optimization across independent two-sphere candidates.
The mesh is used only for simple sphere placement and proximity checks, never as a detector mesh.
The primary profile supplies FSM load/contact evidence only; candidate heel and forefoot forces exclusively generate gait-event guards.
The 1 ms replay is forbidden unless one candidate first passes every 10 ms gate, and it evaluates only that locked candidate plus current geometry.
The operational reference-noise diagnostic can document 50/51 HS within 50 ms with worst HS at most 60 ms, but it never replaces the strict 50 ms gate and can never select or promote a candidate.
No policy, training, rollout, runtime default, FSM, detector profile, or sealed data is modified or evaluated.
objective: Close the residual heel-to-forefoot both-off gaps and early toe-off candidates with a minimal two-sphere detector. Keep H2/F80, move the heel 0/2/4 mm anteriorly and sweep forefoot depths P32.5--P34.0, while preserving strict confirmed HS/TO timing, exact cycles, and swing release.
